The Asante Kotoko board have unveiled the establishment of a female’s team for the 2026/27 football season.
Called Asante Kotoko Ladies, the female team will compete in the Ashanti Region Football Association’s Division One League this season.
The Ghanaian top flight made the announcement on Saturday, November 14, regarding the addition of a new setup to the brand.
“We are proud to officially announce the establishment of Asante Kotoko Ladies, the women’s football team of the legendary Asante Kotoko SC,” the official statement read.
“This historic step represents our commitment to promoting women’s football, empowering female talents, and creating more opportunities for women to shine on the beautiful game.
“A new generation of Queens is ready to carry the Porcupine spirit, passion, pride, and winning mentality onto the pitch.
“The legacy continues. The future is female. The Porcupine family is stronger than ever!”
Kotoko Ladies will play their first game this weekend when they take on Kumasi Sports Academy Ladies at the Otumfuo Park.
